# Quantum Passive Field Sensing

> Single-exposure global minimax estimation of a polynomial field coefficient with a fixed qubit lattice and unknown lower-order spatial phases.

## Scientific routes

- [Model and exact statements](science/model.md): binary occupation generators, identifiable angle, arbitrary nuisance, fixed-aperture conversion and resource assumptions.
- [Minimax proof](science/minimax.md): twirling, consecutive charges, finite Fourier measurement and k-producible lower bound.
- [Lattice construction](science/arithmetic.md): signed finite-difference code, sharp spectral constant, and compact constructive alternative.
- [Worked receiver](science/example.md): eight sensors, three configurations and four outcomes.
- [Robustness](science/robustness.md): diagonal phase error, position perturbation and control assumptions.
- [Related work](references/RELATED_WORK.md): prior DFS, phase estimation, spatial models and exact arithmetic.

## Study and reproduce

- [Learning guide](learning/README.md): one educational anchor, bridge, and milestone map.
- [Verification](verification/README.md): run the deterministic finite checks with Python 3.
